page.notes: The left margin note reads "Iac. c. 4. v. 13. 14. 15.", with the "c" of "c. 4." doubtful, so it is marked. The Greek word "ἀλόγως" is doubtful and marked [?]. The text ends on the hyphenated "præ-", which is continued on the next page. No catchword or signature is visible. The text is from a Jesuit-controversy passage; "palseribus" and "possibilibus" have been normalised to s. The phrase "Digna" is read from the scan with some doubt. The page has no heading.
